q1_issues.issue: Stimulus is used for an ENTITY object of 'watch', but the role list puts watch in Theme's own verb list and reserves Stimulus for a perception verb's eventive complement ('Entity objects only'), so the weathercock group should be Theme.
Same mis-slotting for the second entity object: (Stimulus sk_watch_1 sk_smoke_1) should be Theme, since the hearth smoke is an entity, not a perceived event.

The coordinated objects 'the spire weathercocks and the hearth smoke' are packed onto ONE watch event as two same-role atoms, whereas coordinated NPs are distributive by default (one event per conjunct); the collective one-event form is licensed only for reciprocal/aggregate predicates or an explicit 'together / jointly'.

(Inheritance cold_threshold threshold) is a second round of decomposition on a modifier the compound rule never exposes (a noun modifier) and leaves cold_threshold as an orphan symbol appearing in no other atom, against 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop'.

q2_gaps: a MEANS adjunct of the form 'by V-ing' (a gerund clause naming how the matrix event is carried out): Instrument is restricted to a tool, substance or conduit, and the preposition-named oblique is defined with an NP object, so a reified clausal means has no stated carrier
notes: 'The Keepers' is handled correctly as a Name-only individual with no GroupOf and no per-member kind, per the capitalized-plural-label rule, and the definite plural 'the spire weathercocks' correctly takes a group witness with the fused classifier in its kind slot. Note the instruction set is in tension on watch's object role — the assignment paragraph says 'psych/perception object -> Stimulus' while the Theme entry names watch outright and carves Stimulus down to eventive complements.
